item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Transcription, collation, and analysis of the sources of commentaries and glosses on the Aeneid (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/FLMR-01 Filologie e letterature medio-latina e romanze

Transcription and collation of glosses and commentaries on some books of the Aeneid (complete for witnesses up to the 10th century, sample for loci selecti in humanistic witnesses). Inquiry about the sources and parallel passages for the texts object of the research. Classical Text Editor and Cadmus software will be used in all phases of the research. It is also planned a trial of semi-automatic transcription using the eScriptorium software.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Greel medicine, natural sciences and philosophy in the ancient world: the epistemological foundation of medicine between the Hellenistic age and Galen (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/FICP-01 Filologia greca e latina, letteratura cristiana antica, papirologia

Within the broader project “Ancient Science Ancient Philosophy: the philosophical foundations of science in Antiquity”, the position is dedicated to research on the scientific status of medicine from the Hellenistic period to Galen and the beginnings of Christianity. The research will focus on the gradual development of epistemological awareness after the Hippocratic beginnings. This will be pursued through close analysis of the most significant surviving texts, including their selection, translation and commentary, and, where no reliable modern edition is available, examination of the manuscript and/or indirect tradition. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Design, methodological supervision, for Italian Sign Language assessment and certification. (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-05 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/GLOT-01 Glottologia e linguistica

The research concerns the design, methodological coordination, and psychometric and statistical validation of tools for the assessment and certification of proficiency in Italian Sign Language (LIS). The activities will include defining the validation design, overseeing data collection and quality-control procedures, and applying psychometric methods and advanced statistical models to analyse reliability, validity, internal consistency, and item quality. They will also include the development of standardised protocols, technical and scientific reports, and operational recommendations to ensure fairness, accuracy, and comparability in the measurement of language proficiency.

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: ERC MUSICA FRANCA - Literary and musical connections between Old French and Middle High German Lyrics (ROMA "La Sapienza")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-13 23:59
Institution: ROMA "La Sapienza", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/GERM-01 Filologie, lingue, letterature e culture germaniche

The work will be complementary to the ERC project MUSICA FRANCA and will contribute to the research strand dedicated to the study of literary, musical, and cultural connections between France and Central and Eastern Europe, with a particular focus on the lyric poetry of the Middle High German *Minnesänger*. Activities will be carried out on-site at the project laboratory located within the Department, in close collaboration with the team. These will include participating in the digital edition of *trouvère* lyric poetry, contributing to the development of the project’s digital platform, and preparing a monograph aligned with the project’s objectives.
